letter.to: The Nodal Officer, Neblio Technologies Private Limited (CoinDCX)
letter.subject: Request for KYC records, transaction records, a freeze and preservation of records in respect of 2 wallets attributed to CoinDCX (DEMO/2026/101 and DEMO/2026/104)
paragraphs: This office is investigating the 2 matters referred to above (DEMO/2026/101 and DEMO/2026/104).

Analysis of public blockchain records traced funds from the wallets under investigation (TYJD2hZKBNrcKW2gYUTV6rJJ2nYie2HP1c on Tron, DEMO/2026/101 and TGfoGrh8ddh4zzpBe3G82p1tgmeUq49sWr on Tron, DEMO/2026/104) to the 2 wallets listed in the table below, which the analysis attributes to CoinDCX. The table states, for each wallet, the amount traced, the transactions, and the evidence tier and confidence of the attribution.

You are requested to: (a) furnish the KYC and account-opening records of the account or accounts that the wallets listed below belong to, or that were credited through them; (b) furnish the transaction history of those accounts, including the deposits listed below, internal transfers, withdrawals and the destination of the funds; (c) freeze those accounts to the extent of the amounts listed below, and confirm the freeze and the balance held; (d) preserve all records, logs and communications relating to those accounts until further notice.
